sanskrit_verse: अशक्तौ भेषजस्यार्थे यज्ञहेतोस्तथैव च। यद्यवश्यं तु विक्रेयास्तिला धान्येन तत्सामाः॥
transliteration: aśaktau bheṣajasyārthe yajñahetos tathaiva ca | yady avaśyaṃ tu vikreyās tilā dhānyena tatsāmāḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When capacity for medicinal purpose or ritual obligation is absent, and sale becomes inevitable, sesame seeds and grains must be exchanged only with equivalent value.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from necessity aligned with dharma
Causation is rooted in dharmic function, not personal desire
Capacity-based responsibility requires equivalence in exchange
Restoration logic demands proportionality in transactional dharma
Consciousness alignment occurs through integrity-preserving trade
executable_legal_axioms: IF a person lacks medicinal or ritual resources AND exchange is necessary THEN only equivalent-value goods may be transacted
IF tila or dhanya are offered in exchange THEN their measure must match functional equivalency of original need
IF transaction bypasses equivalence THEN completion-process initiates until balance is restored
IF causal necessity is absent THEN transaction invalidity is declared by default
supreme_court_application: In adjudication involving economic exchange under duress or dharmic compulsion, the threshold of responsibility lies in verifying causal necessity. The court must assess whether the transaction preserves functional equivalence and aligns with dharma-based capacity rather than market-driven disparity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that transactions stem from verified necessity, not speculative gain. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals the sequential emergence of need, intent, and action. Proportional responsibility ensures no loss of integrity. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that imbalance is corrected through restorative completion, not punitive imposition.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate equivalence audit to determine true functional value
Engage party in conscious reaffirmation of dharmic intent
Execute reversal or rebalancing process until energetic parity is restored
Reintegrate participant into dharmic economic flow without shame or penalty
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law is executed. Dharma is restored through conscious exchange. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness stands as the supreme adjudicator.
